Boolean properties:
	account_login_boots_in_use: if FALSE, oldest connection to account is not booted when new connection occurs (current is True, default is True)
	advanced_combat_pets: (non-retail function) If enabled, Combat Pets can cast spells (current is False, default is False)
	advocate_fane_auto_bestow: If enabled, Advocate Fane will automatically bestow new advocates to advocate_fane_auto_bestow_level (current is False, default is False)
	aetheria_heal_color: If enabled, changes the aetheria healing over time messages from the default retail red color to green (current is False, default is False)
	allow_combat_mode_crafting: If enabled, allows players to do crafting (recipes) from all stances. Forces players to NonCombat first, then continues to recipe action. (current is False, default is False)
	allow_door_hold: enables retail behavior where standing on a door while it is closing keeps the door as ethereal until it is free from collisions, effectively holding the door open for other players (current is True, default is True)
	allow_fast_chug: enables retail behavior where a player can consume food and drink faster than normal by breaking animation (current is True, default is True)
	allow_highres_dat: enables client to use highres dat for graphics (current is False, default is False)
	allow_jump_loot: enables retail behavior where a player can quickly loot items while jumping, bypassing the 'crouch down' animation (current is True, default is True)
	allow_negative_dispel_resist: enables retail behavior where #-# negative dispels can be resisted (current is True, default is True)
	allow_negative_rating_curve: enables retail behavior where negative DRR from void dots didn't switch to the reverse rating formula, resulting in a possibly unintended curve that quickly ramps up as -rating goes down, eventually approaching infinity / divide by 0 for -100 rating. less than -100 rating would produce negative numbers. (current is True, default is True)
	allow_pkl_bump: enables retail behavior where /pkl checks for entry collisions, bumping the player position over if standing on another PKLite. This effectively enables /pkl door skipping from retail (current is True, default is True)
	allow_summoning_killtask_multicredit: enables retail behavior where a summoner can get multiple killtask credits from a monster (current is True, default is True)
	assess_creature_mod: (non-retail function) If enabled, re-enables former skill formula, when assess creature skill is not trained or spec'ed (current is False, default is False)
	attribute_augmentation_safety_cap: if TRUE players are not able to use attribute augmentations if the innate value of the target attribute is >= 96. All normal restrictions to these augmentations still apply. (current is True, default is True)
	chat_disable_general: disable general global chat channel (current is False, default is False)
	chat_disable_lfg: disable lfg global chat channel (current is False, default is False)
	chat_disable_olthoi: disable olthoi global chat channel (current is False, default is False)
	chat_disable_roleplay: disable roleplay global chat channel (current is False, default is False)
	chat_disable_trade: disable trade global chat channel (current is False, default is False)
	chat_echo_only: global chat returns to sender only (current is False, default is False)
	chat_echo_reject: global chat returns to sender on reject (current is False, default is False)
	chat_inform_reject: global chat informs sender on reason for reject (current is True, default is True)
	chat_log_abuse: log abuse chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_admin: log admin chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_advocate: log advocate chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_allegiance: log allegiance chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_audit: log audit chat (current is True, default is True)
	chat_log_debug: log debug chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_fellow: log fellow chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_general: log general chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_global: log global broadcasts (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_help: log help chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_lfg: log LFG chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_olthoi: log olthoi chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_qa: log QA chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_roleplay: log roleplay chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_sentinel: log sentinel chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_society: log society chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_trade: log trade chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_log_townchans: log advocate town chat (current is False, default is False)
	chat_requires_account_15days: global chat privileges requires accounts to be 15 days or older (current is False, default is False)
	chess_enabled: if FALSE then chess will be disabled (current is True, default is True)
	use_cloak_proc_custom_scale: If TRUE, the calculation for cloak procs will be based upon the values set by the server oeprator. (current is False, default is False)
	client_movement_formula: If enabled, server uses DoMotion/StopMotion self-client movement methods instead of apply_raw_movement (current is False, default is False)
	container_opener_name: If enabled, when a player tries to open a container that is already in use by someone else, replaces 'someone else' in the message with the actual name of the player (current is False, default is False)
	corpse_decay_tick_logging: If ENABLED then player corpse ticks will be logged (current is False, default is False)
	corpse_destroy_pyreals: If FALSE then pyreals will not be completely destroyed on player death (current is True, default is True)
	craft_exact_msg: If TRUE, and player has crafting chance of success dialog enabled, shows them an additional message in their chat window with exact % (current is False, default is False)
	creature_name_check: if enabled, creature names in world database restricts player names during character creation (current is True, default is True)
	creatures_drop_createlist_wield: If FALSE then Wielded items in CreateList will not drop. Retail defaulted to TRUE but there are currently data errors (current is False, default is False)
	fastbuff: If TRUE, enables the fast buffing trick from retail. (current is True, default is True)
	fellow_busy_no_recruit: if FALSE, fellows can be recruited while they are busy, different from retail (current is True, default is True)
	fellow_kt_killer: if FALSE, fellowship kill tasks will share with the fellowship, even if the killer doesn't have the quest (current is True, default is True)
	fellow_kt_landblock: if TRUE, fellowship kill tasks will share with landblock range (192 distance radius, or entire dungeon) (current is False, default is False)
	fellow_quest_bonus: if TRUE, applies EvenShare formula to fellowship quest reward XP (300% max bonus, defaults to false in retail) (current is False, default is False)
	fix_chest_missing_inventory_window: Very non-standard fix. This fixes an acclient bug where unlocking a chest, and then quickly opening it before the client has received the Locked=false update from server can result in the chest opening, but with the chest inventory window not displaying. Bug has a higher chance of appearing with more network latency. (current is False, default is False)
	gateway_ties_summonable: if disabled, players cannot summon ties from gateways. defaults to enabled, as in retail (current is True, default is True)
	gearknight_core_plating: if disabled, Gear Knight players are not required to use core plating devices for armor and clothing. defaults to enabled, as in retail (current is True, default is True)
	house_15day_account: if disabled, houses can be purchased with accounts created less than 15 days old (current is True, default is True)
	house_30day_cooldown: if disabled, houses can be purchased without waiting 30 days between each purchase (current is True, default is True)
	house_hook_limit: if disabled, house hook limits are ignored (current is True, default is True)
	house_hookgroup_limit: if disabled, house hook group limits are ignored (current is True, default is True)
	house_per_char: if TRUE, allows 1 house per char instead of 1 house per account (current is False, default is False)
	house_purchase_requirements: if disabled, requirements to purchase/rent house are not checked (current is True, default is True)
	house_rent_enabled: If FALSE then rent is not required (current is True, default is True)
	iou_trades: (non-retail function) If enabled, IOUs can be traded for objects that are missing in DB but added/restored later on (current is False, default is False)
	item_dispel: if enabled, allows players to dispel items. defaults to end of retail, where item dispels could only target creatures (current is False, default is False)
	lifestone_broadcast_death: if true, player deaths are additionally broadcast to other players standing near the destination lifestone (current is True, default is True)
	loot_quality_mod: if FALSE then the loot quality modifier of a Death Treasure profile does not affect loot generation (current is True, default is True)
	npc_hairstyle_fullrange: if TRUE, allows generated creatures to use full range of hairstyles. Retail only allowed first nine (0-8) out of 51 (current is False, default is False)
	offline_xp_passup_limit: if FALSE, allows unlimited xp to passup to offline characters in allegiances (current is True, default is True)
	olthoi_play_disabled: if false, allows players to create and play as olthoi characters (current is False, default is False)
	override_encounter_spawn_rates: if enabled, landblock encounter spawns are overidden by double properties below. (current is False, default is False)
	permit_corpse_all: If TRUE, /permit grants permittees access to all corpses of the permitter. Defaults to FALSE as per retail, where /permit only grants access to 1 locked corpse (current is False, default is False)
	persist_movement: If TRUE, persists autonomous movements such as turns and sidesteps through non-autonomous server actions. Retail didn't appear to do this, but some players may prefer this. (current is False, default is False)
	pet_stow_replace: pet stowing for different pet devices becomes a stow and replace. defaults to retail value of false (current is False, default is False)
	player_config_command: If enabled, players can use /config to change their settings via text commands (current is False, default is False)
	player_receive_immediate_save: if enabled, when the player receives items from an NPC, they will be saved immediately (current is False, default is False)
	pk_server: set this to TRUE for darktide servers (current is False, default is False)
	pk_server_safe_training_academy: set this to TRUE to disable pk fighting in training academy and time to exit starter town safely (current is False, default is False)
	pkl_server: set this to TRUE for pink servers (current is False, default is False)
	quest_info_enabled: toggles the /myquests player command (current is False, default is False)
	rares_real_time: allow for second chance roll based on an rng seeded timestamp for a rare on rare eligible kills that do not generate a rare, rares_max_seconds_between defines maximum seconds before second chance kicks in (current is True, default is True)
	rares_real_time_v2: chances for a rare to be generated on rare eligible kills are modified by the last time one was found per each player, rares_max_days_between defines maximum days before guaranteed rare generation (current is False, default is False)
	runrate_add_hooks: if TRUE, adds some runrate hooks that were missing from retail (exhaustion done, raise skill/attribute (current is False, default is False)
	reportbug_enabled: toggles the /reportbug player command (current is False, default is False)
	require_spell_comps: if FALSE, spell components are no longer required to be in inventory to cast spells. defaults to enabled, as in retail (current is True, default is True)
	safe_spell_comps: if TRUE, disables spell component burning for everyone (current is False, default is False)
	salvage_handle_overages: in retail, if 2 salvage bags were combined beyond 100 structure, the overages would be lost (current is False, default is False)
	show_ammo_buff: shows active enchantments such as blood drinker on equipped missile ammo during appraisal (current is False, default is False)
	show_aura_buff: shows active aura enchantments on wielded items during appraisal (current is False, default is False)
	show_dat_warning: if TRUE, will alert player (dat_warning_msg) when client attempts to download from server and boot them from game, disabled by default (current is False, default is False)
	show_dot_messages: enabled, shows combat messages for DoT damage ticks. defaults to disabled, as in retail (current is False, default is False)
	show_first_login_gift: if TRUE, will show on first login that the player earned bonus item (Blackmoor's Favor and/or Asheron's Benediction), disabled by default because msg is kind of odd on an emulator (current is False, default is False)
	show_mana_conv_bonus_0: if disabled, only shows mana conversion bonus if not zero, during appraisal of casting items (current is True, default is True)
	smite_uses_takedamage: if enabled, smite applies damage via TakeDamage (current is False, default is False)
	spellcast_recoil_queue: if true, players can queue the next spell to cast during recoil animation (current is False, default is False)
	spell_projectile_ethereal: broadcasts all spell projectiles as ethereal to clients only, and manually send stop velocity on collision. can fix various issues with client missing target id. (current is False, default is False)
	suicide_instant_death: if enabled, @die command kills player instantly. defaults to disabled, as in retail (current is False, default is False)
	taboo_table: if enabled, taboo table restricts player names during character creation (current is True, default is True)
	tailoring_intermediate_uieffects: If true, tailoring intermediate icons retain the magical/elemental highlight of the original item (current is False, default is False)
	trajectory_alt_solver: use the alternate trajectory solver for missiles and spell projectiles (current is False, default is False)
	universal_masteries: if TRUE, matches end of retail masteries - players wielding almost any weapon get +5 DR, except if the weapon "seems tough to master". if FALSE, players start with mastery of 1 melee and 1 ranged weapon type based on heritage, and can later re-select these 2 masteries (current is True, default is True)
	unlimited_sequence_gaps: upon startup, allows server to find all unused guids in a range instead of a set hard limit (current is False, default is False)
	use_generator_rotation_offset: enables or disables using the generator's current rotation when offseting relative positions (current is True, default is True)
	use_portal_max_level_requirement: disable this to ignore the max level restriction on portals (current is True, default is True)
	use_turbine_chat: enables or disables global chat channels (General, LFG, Roleplay, Trade, Olthoi, Society, Allegience) (current is True, default is True)
	use_wield_requirements: disable this to bypass wield requirements. mostly for dev debugging (current is True, default is True)
	version_info_enabled: toggles the /aceversion player command (current is False, default is False)
	vendor_shop_uses_generator: enables or disables vendors using generator system in addition to createlist to create artificial scarcity (current is False, default is False)
	world_closed: enable this to startup world as a closed to players world (current is False, default is False)

Long properties:
	char_delete_time: the amount of time in seconds a deleted character can be restored (current is 3600, default is 3600)
	chat_requires_account_time_seconds: the amount of time in seconds an account is required to have existed for for global chat privileges (current is 0, default is 0)
	chat_requires_player_age: the amount of time in seconds a player is required to have played for global chat privileges (current is 0, default is 0)
	chat_requires_player_level: the level a player is required to have for global chat privileges (current is 0, default is 0)
	corpse_spam_limit: the number of corpses a player is allowed to leave on a landblock at one time (current is 15, default is 15)
	default_subscription_level: retail defaults to 1, 1 = standard subscription (same as 2 and 3), 4 grants ToD pre-order bonus item Asheron's Benediction (current is 1, default is 1)
	fellowship_even_share_level: level when fellowship XP sharing is no longer restricted (current is 50, default is 50)
	mansion_min_rank: overrides the default allegiance rank required to own a mansion (current is 6, default is 6)
	max_chars_per_account: retail defaults to 11, client supports up to 20 (current is 11, default is 11)
	pk_timer: the number of seconds where a player cannot perform certain actions (ie. teleporting) after becoming involved in a PK battle (current is 20, default is 20)
	player_save_interval: the number of seconds between automatic player saves (current is 300, default is 300)
	rares_max_days_between: for rares_real_time_v2: the maximum number of days a player can go before a rare is generated on rare eligible creature kills (current is 45, default is 45)
	rares_max_seconds_between: for rares_real_time: the maximum number of seconds a player can go before a second chance at a rare is allowed on rare eligible creature kills that did not generate a rare (current is 5256000, default is 5256000)
	summoning_killtask_multicredit_cap: if allow_summoning_killtask_multicredit is enabled, the maximum # of killtask credits a player can receive from 1 kill (current is 2, default is 2)
	teleport_visibility_fix: Fixes some possible issues with invisible players and mobs. 0 = default / disabled, 1 = players only, 2 = creatures, 3 = all world objects (current is 0, default is 0)

Double properties:
	cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for cantrips to drop in each tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	cloak_cooldown_seconds: The number of seconds between possible cloak procs. (current is 5, default is 5)
	cloak_max_proc_base: The max proc chance of a cloak. (current is 0.25, default is 0.25)
	cloak_max_proc_damage_percentage: The damage percentage at which cloak proc chance plateaus. (current is 0.3, default is 0.3)
	cloak_min_proc: The minimum proc chance of a cloak. (current is 0, default is 0)
	minor_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for minor cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	major_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for major cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	epic_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for epic cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	legendary_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for legendary cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	advocate_fane_auto_bestow_level: the level that advocates are automatically bestowed by Advocate Fane if advocate_fane_auto_bestow is true (current is 1, default is 1)
	aetheria_drop_rate: Modifier for Aetheria drop rate, 1 being normal (current is 1, default is 1)
	chess_ai_start_time: the number of seconds for the chess ai to start. defaults to -1 (disabled) (current is -1, default is -1)
	encounter_delay: the number of seconds a generator profile for regions is delayed from returning to free slots (current is 1800, default is 1800)
	encounter_regen_interval: the number of seconds a generator for regions at which spawns its next set of objects (current is 600, default is 600)
	fast_missile_modifier: The speed multiplier applied to fast missiles. Defaults to retail value of 1.2 (current is 1.2, default is 1.2)
	ignore_magic_armor_pvp_scalar: Scales the effectiveness of IgnoreMagicArmor (ie. hollow weapons) in pvp battles. 1.0 = full effectiveness / ignore all enchantments on armor (default), 0.5 = half effectiveness / use half enchantments from armor, 0.0 = no effectiveness / use full enchantments from armor (current is 1, default is 1)
	ignore_magic_resist_pvp_scalar: Scales the effectiveness of IgnoreMagicResist (ie. hollow weapons) in pvp battles. 1.0 = full effectiveness / ignore all resistances from life enchantments (default), 0.5 = half effectiveness / use half resistances from life enchantments, 0.0 = no effectiveness / use full resistances from life enchantments (current is 1, default is 1)
	luminance_modifier: Scales the amount of luminance received by players (current is 1, default is 1)
	melee_max_angle: for melee players, the maximum angle before a TurnTo is required. retail appeared to have required a TurnTo even for the smallest of angle offsets. (current is 0, default is 0)
	mob_awareness_range: Scales the distance the monsters become alerted and aggro the players (current is 1, default is 1)
	pk_new_character_grace_period: the number of seconds, in addition to pk_respite_timer, that a player killer is set to non-player killer status after first exiting training academy (current is 300, default is 300)
	pk_respite_timer: the number of seconds that a player killer is set to non-player killer status after dying to another player killer (current is 300, default is 300)
	quest_lum_modifier: Scale multiplier for amount of quest luminance received by players.  Quest lum is also modified by 'luminance_modifier'. (current is 1, default is 1)
	quest_mindelta_rate: scales all quest min delta time between solves, 1 being normal (current is 1, default is 1)
	quest_xp_modifier: Scale multiplier for amount of quest XP received by players.  Quest XP is also modified by 'xp_modifier'. (current is 1, default is 1)
	rare_drop_rate_percent: Adjust the chance of a rare to spawn as a percentage. Default is 0.04, or 1 in 2,500. Max is 100, or every eligible drop. (current is 0.04, default is 0.04)
	spellcast_max_angle: for advanced player spell casting, the maximum angle to target release a spell projectile. retail seemed to default to value of around 20, although some players seem to prefer a higher 45 degree angle (current is 20, default is 20)
	trophy_drop_rate: Modifier for trophies dropped on creature death (current is 1, default is 1)
	unlocker_window: The number of seconds a player unlocking a chest has exclusive access to first opening the chest. (current is 10, default is 10)
	vendor_unique_rot_time: the number of seconds before unique items sold to vendors disappear (current is 300, default is 300)
	vitae_penalty: the amount of vitae penalty a player gets per death (current is 0.05, default is 0.05)
	vitae_penalty_max: the maximum vitae penalty a player can have (current is 0.4, default is 0.4)
	void_pvp_modifier: Scales the amount of damage players take from Void Magic. Defaults to 0.5, as per retail. For earlier content where DRR isn't as readily available, this can be adjusted for balance. (current is 0.5, default is 0.5)
	xp_modifier: scales the amount of xp received by players (current is 1, default is 1)

String properties:
	content_folder: for content creators to live edit weenies. defaults to Content folder found in same directory as ACE.Server.dll (default is hidden)
	dat_older_warning_msg: Warning message displayed (if show_dat_warning is true) to player if client attempts DAT download from server (default is hidden)
	dat_newer_warning_msg: Warning message displayed (if show_dat_warning is true) to player if client connects to this server (default is hidden)
	popup_header: Welcome message displayed when you log in (default is hidden)
	popup_welcome: Welcome message popup in training halls (default is hidden)
	popup_welcome_olthoi: Welcome message displayed on the first login for an Olthoi Player (default is hidden)
	popup_motd: Popup message of the day (default is hidden)
	server_motd: Server message of the day (default is hidden)

	creature_name_check: if enabled, creature names in world database restricts player names during character creation (current is True, default is True)
	creatures_drop_createlist_wield: If FALSE then Wielded items in CreateList will not drop. Retail defaulted to TRUE but there are currently data errors (current is False, default is False)
	fastbuff: If TRUE, enables the fast buffing trick from retail. (current is True, default is True)
	fellow_busy_no_recruit: if FALSE, fellows can be recruited while they are busy, different from retail (current is True, default is True)
	fellow_kt_killer: if FALSE, fellowship kill tasks will share with the fellowship, even if the killer doesn't have the quest (current is True, default is True)
	fellow_kt_landblock: if TRUE, fellowship kill tasks will share with landblock range (192 distance radius, or entire dungeon) (current is False, default is False)
	fellow_quest_bonus: if TRUE, applies EvenShare formula to fellowship quest reward XP (300% max bonus, defaults to false in retail) (current is False, default is False)
	fix_chest_missing_inventory_window: Very non-standard fix. This fixes an acclient bug where unlocking a chest, and then quickly opening it before the client has received the Locked=false update from server can result in the chest opening, but with the chest inventory window not displaying. Bug has a higher chance of appearing with more network latency. (current is False, default is False)
	gateway_ties_summonable: if disabled, players cannot summon ties from gateways. defaults to enabled, as in retail (current is True, default is True)
	gearknight_core_plating: if disabled, Gear Knight players are not required to use core plating devices for armor and clothing. defaults to enabled, as in retail (current is True, default is True)
	house_15day_account: if disabled, houses can be purchased with accounts created less than 15 days old (current is True, default is True)
	house_30day_cooldown: if disabled, houses can be purchased without waiting 30 days between each purchase (current is True, default is True)
	house_hook_limit: if disabled, house hook limits are ignored (current is True, default is True)
	house_hookgroup_limit: if disabled, house hook group limits are ignored (current is True, default is True)
	house_per_char: if TRUE, allows 1 house per char instead of 1 house per account (current is False, default is False)
	house_purchase_requirements: if disabled, requirements to purchase/rent house are not checked (current is True, default is True)
	house_rent_enabled: If FALSE then rent is not required (current is True, default is True)
	iou_trades: (non-retail function) If enabled, IOUs can be traded for objects that are missing in DB but added/restored later on (current is False, default is False)
	item_dispel: if enabled, allows players to dispel items. defaults to end of retail, where item dispels could only target creatures (current is False, default is False)
	lifestone_broadcast_death: if true, player deaths are additionally broadcast to other players standing near the destination lifestone (current is True, default is True)
	loot_quality_mod: if FALSE then the loot quality modifier of a Death Treasure profile does not affect loot generation (current is True, default is True)
	npc_hairstyle_fullrange: if TRUE, allows generated creatures to use full range of hairstyles. Retail only allowed first nine (0-8) out of 51 (current is False, default is False)
	offline_xp_passup_limit: if FALSE, allows unlimited xp to passup to offline characters in allegiances (current is True, default is True)
	olthoi_play_disabled: if false, allows players to create and play as olthoi characters (current is False, default is False)
	override_encounter_spawn_rates: if enabled, landblock encounter spawns are overidden by double properties below. (current is False, default is False)
	permit_corpse_all: If TRUE, /permit grants permittees access to all corpses of the permitter. Defaults to FALSE as per retail, where /permit only grants access to 1 locked corpse (current is False, default is False)
	persist_movement: If TRUE, persists autonomous movements such as turns and sidesteps through non-autonomous server actions. Retail didn't appear to do this, but some players may prefer this. (current is False, default is False)
	pet_stow_replace: pet stowing for different pet devices becomes a stow and replace. defaults to retail value of false (current is False, default is False)
	player_config_command: If enabled, players can use /config to change their settings via text commands (current is False, default is False)
	player_receive_immediate_save: if enabled, when the player receives items from an NPC, they will be saved immediately (current is False, default is False)
	pk_server: set this to TRUE for darktide servers (current is False, default is False)
	pk_server_safe_training_academy: set this to TRUE to disable pk fighting in training academy and time to exit starter town safely (current is False, default is False)
	pkl_server: set this to TRUE for pink servers (current is False, default is False)
	quest_info_enabled: toggles the /myquests player command (current is False, default is False)
	rares_real_time: allow for second chance roll based on an rng seeded timestamp for a rare on rare eligible kills that do not generate a rare, rares_max_seconds_between defines maximum seconds before second chance kicks in (current is True, default is True)
	rares_real_time_v2: chances for a rare to be generated on rare eligible kills are modified by the last time one was found per each player, rares_max_days_between defines maximum days before guaranteed rare generation (current is False, default is False)
	runrate_add_hooks: if TRUE, adds some runrate hooks that were missing from retail (exhaustion done, raise skill/attribute (current is False, default is False)
	reportbug_enabled: toggles the /reportbug player command (current is False, default is False)
	require_spell_comps: if FALSE, spell components are no longer required to be in inventory to cast spells. defaults to enabled, as in retail (current is True, default is True)
	safe_spell_comps: if TRUE, disables spell component burning for everyone (current is False, default is False)
	salvage_handle_overages: in retail, if 2 salvage bags were combined beyond 100 structure, the overages would be lost (current is False, default is False)
	show_ammo_buff: shows active enchantments such as blood drinker on equipped missile ammo during appraisal (current is False, default is False)
	show_aura_buff: shows active aura enchantments on wielded items during appraisal (current is False, default is False)
	show_dat_warning: if TRUE, will alert player (dat_warning_msg) when client attempts to download from server and boot them from game, disabled by default (current is False, default is False)
	show_dot_messages: enabled, shows combat messages for DoT damage ticks. defaults to disabled, as in retail (current is False, default is False)
	show_first_login_gift: if TRUE, will show on first login that the player earned bonus item (Blackmoor's Favor and/or Asheron's Benediction), disabled by default because msg is kind of odd on an emulator (current is False, default is False)
	show_mana_conv_bonus_0: if disabled, only shows mana conversion bonus if not zero, during appraisal of casting items (current is True, default is True)
	smite_uses_takedamage: if enabled, smite applies damage via TakeDamage (current is False, default is False)
	spellcast_recoil_queue: if true, players can queue the next spell to cast during recoil animation (current is False, default is False)
	spell_projectile_ethereal: broadcasts all spell projectiles as ethereal to clients only, and manually send stop velocity on collision. can fix various issues with client missing target id. (current is False, default is False)
	suicide_instant_death: if enabled, @die command kills player instantly. defaults to disabled, as in retail (current is False, default is False)
	taboo_table: if enabled, taboo table restricts player names during character creation (current is True, default is True)
	tailoring_intermediate_uieffects: If true, tailoring intermediate icons retain the magical/elemental highlight of the original item (current is False, default is False)
	trajectory_alt_solver: use the alternate trajectory solver for missiles and spell projectiles (current is False, default is False)
	universal_masteries: if TRUE, matches end of retail masteries - players wielding almost any weapon get +5 DR, except if the weapon "seems tough to master". if FALSE, players start with mastery of 1 melee and 1 ranged weapon type based on heritage, and can later re-select these 2 masteries (current is True, default is True)
	unlimited_sequence_gaps: upon startup, allows server to find all unused guids in a range instead of a set hard limit (current is False, default is False)
	use_generator_rotation_offset: enables or disables using the generator's current rotation when offseting relative positions (current is True, default is True)
	use_portal_max_level_requirement: disable this to ignore the max level restriction on portals (current is True, default is True)
	use_turbine_chat: enables or disables global chat channels (General, LFG, Roleplay, Trade, Olthoi, Society, Allegience) (current is True, default is True)
	use_wield_requirements: disable this to bypass wield requirements. mostly for dev debugging (current is True, default is True)
	version_info_enabled: toggles the /aceversion player command (current is False, default is False)
	vendor_shop_uses_generator: enables or disables vendors using generator system in addition to createlist to create artificial scarcity (current is False, default is False)
	world_closed: enable this to startup world as a closed to players world (current is True, default is False)

Long properties:
	char_delete_time: the amount of time in seconds a deleted character can be restored (current is 3600, default is 3600)
	chat_requires_account_time_seconds: the amount of time in seconds an account is required to have existed for for global chat privileges (current is 0, default is 0)
	chat_requires_player_age: the amount of time in seconds a player is required to have played for global chat privileges (current is 0, default is 0)
	chat_requires_player_level: the level a player is required to have for global chat privileges (current is 0, default is 0)
	corpse_spam_limit: the number of corpses a player is allowed to leave on a landblock at one time (current is 15, default is 15)
	default_subscription_level: retail defaults to 1, 1 = standard subscription (same as 2 and 3), 4 grants ToD pre-order bonus item Asheron's Benediction (current is 1, default is 1)
	fellowship_even_share_level: level when fellowship XP sharing is no longer restricted (current is 50, default is 50)
	mansion_min_rank: overrides the default allegiance rank required to own a mansion (current is 6, default is 6)
	max_chars_per_account: retail defaults to 11, client supports up to 20 (current is 20, default is 11)
	pk_timer: the number of seconds where a player cannot perform certain actions (ie. teleporting) after becoming involved in a PK battle (current is 20, default is 20)
	player_save_interval: the number of seconds between automatic player saves (current is 300, default is 300)
	rares_max_days_between: for rares_real_time_v2: the maximum number of days a player can go before a rare is generated on rare eligible creature kills (current is 45, default is 45)
	rares_max_seconds_between: for rares_real_time: the maximum number of seconds a player can go before a second chance at a rare is allowed on rare eligible creature kills that did not generate a rare (current is 5256000, default is 5256000)
	summoning_killtask_multicredit_cap: if allow_summoning_killtask_multicredit is enabled, the maximum # of killtask credits a player can receive from 1 kill (current is 2, default is 2)
	teleport_visibility_fix: Fixes some possible issues with invisible players and mobs. 0 = default / disabled, 1 = players only, 2 = creatures, 3 = all world objects (current is 0, default is 0)

Double properties:
	cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for cantrips to drop in each tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	cloak_cooldown_seconds: The number of seconds between possible cloak procs. (current is 5, default is 5)
	cloak_max_proc_base: The max proc chance of a cloak. (current is 0.25, default is 0.25)
	cloak_max_proc_damage_percentage: The damage percentage at which cloak proc chance plateaus. (current is 0.3, default is 0.3)
	cloak_min_proc: The minimum proc chance of a cloak. (current is 0, default is 0)
	minor_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for minor cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	major_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for major cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	epic_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for epic cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	legendary_cantrip_drop_rate: Scales the chance for legendary cantrips to drop, relative to other cantrip levels in the tier. Defaults to 1.0, as per end of retail (current is 1, default is 1)
	advocate_fane_auto_bestow_level: the level that advocates are automatically bestowed by Advocate Fane if advocate_fane_auto_bestow is true (current is 1, default is 1)
	aetheria_drop_rate: Modifier for Aetheria drop rate, 1 being normal (current is 1, default is 1)
	chess_ai_start_time: the number of seconds for the chess ai to start. defaults to -1 (disabled) (current is -1, default is -1)
	encounter_delay: the number of seconds a generator profile for regions is delayed from returning to free slots (current is 1800, default is 1800)
	encounter_regen_interval: the number of seconds a generator for regions at which spawns its next set of objects (current is 600, default is 600)
	fast_missile_modifier: The speed multiplier applied to fast missiles. Defaults to retail value of 1.2 (current is 1.2, default is 1.2)
	ignore_magic_armor_pvp_scalar: Scales the effectiveness of IgnoreMagicArmor (ie. hollow weapons) in pvp battles. 1.0 = full effectiveness / ignore all enchantments on armor (default), 0.5 = half effectiveness / use half enchantments from armor, 0.0 = no effectiveness / use full enchantments from armor (current is 1, default is 1)
	ignore_magic_resist_pvp_scalar: Scales the effectiveness of IgnoreMagicResist (ie. hollow weapons) in pvp battles. 1.0 = full effectiveness / ignore all resistances from life enchantments (default), 0.5 = half effectiveness / use half resistances from life enchantments, 0.0 = no effectiveness / use full resistances from life enchantments (current is 1, default is 1)
	luminance_modifier: Scales the amount of luminance received by players (current is 1, default is 1)
	melee_max_angle: for melee players, the maximum angle before a TurnTo is required. retail appeared to have required a TurnTo even for the smallest of angle offsets. (current is 0, default is 0)
	mob_awareness_range: Scales the distance the monsters become alerted and aggro the players (current is 1, default is 1)
	pk_new_character_grace_period: the number of seconds, in addition to pk_respite_timer, that a player killer is set to non-player killer status after first exiting training academy (current is 300, default is 300)
	pk_respite_timer: the number of seconds that a player killer is set to non-player killer status after dying to another player killer (current is 300, default is 300)
	quest_lum_modifier: Scale multiplier for amount of quest luminance received by players.  Quest lum is also modified by 'luminance_modifier'. (current is 1, default is 1)
	quest_mindelta_rate: scales all quest min delta time between solves, 1 being normal (current is 1, default is 1)
	quest_xp_modifier: Scale multiplier for amount of quest XP received by players.  Quest XP is also modified by 'xp_modifier'. (current is 1, default is 1)
	rare_drop_rate_percent: Adjust the chance of a rare to spawn as a percentage. Default is 0.04, or 1 in 2,500. Max is 100, or every eligible drop. (current is 0.04, default is 0.04)
	spellcast_max_angle: for advanced player spell casting, the maximum angle to target release a spell projectile. retail seemed to default to value of around 20, although some players seem to prefer a higher 45 degree angle (current is 20, default is 20)
	trophy_drop_rate: Modifier for trophies dropped on creature death (current is 1, default is 1)
	unlocker_window: The number of seconds a player unlocking a chest has exclusive access to first opening the chest. (current is 10, default is 10)
	vendor_unique_rot_time: the number of seconds before unique items sold to vendors disappear (current is 300, default is 300)
	vitae_penalty: the amount of vitae penalty a player gets per death (current is 0.30000000000000004, default is 0.05)
	vitae_penalty_max: the maximum vitae penalty a player can have (current is 0.4, default is 0.4)
	void_pvp_modifier: Scales the amount of damage players take from Void Magic. Defaults to 0.5, as per retail. For earlier content where DRR isn't as readily available, this can be adjusted for balance. (current is 0.5, default is 0.5)
	xp_modifier: scales the amount of xp received by players (current is 2.5, default is 1)

String properties:
	content_folder: for content creators to live edit weenies. defaults to Content folder found in same directory as ACE.Server.dll (default is hidden)
	dat_older_warning_msg: Warning message displayed (if show_dat_warning is true) to player if client attempts DAT download from server (default is hidden)
	dat_newer_warning_msg: Warning message displayed (if show_dat_warning is true) to player if client connects to this server (default is hidden)
	popup_header: Welcome message displayed when you log in (default is hidden)
	popup_welcome: Welcome message popup in training halls (default is hidden)
	popup_welcome_olthoi: Welcome message displayed on the first login for an Olthoi Player (default is hidden)
	popup_motd: Popup message of the day (default is hidden)
	server_motd: Server message of the day (default is hidden)

source.notes: Steps run in order on ACE's static PropertyManager after LoadDefaultProperties. in: {op, key, value}; out: the call's result (Get*: {item, description}; Modify*: the bool; ListProperties: the text).
